title: Bottle design (*.bottle.json)
description: Input of scripts/bottle_designer.py. Colours in [r,g,b,a] are LINEAR floats; hex strings (#rrggbb) are sRGB and converted. Paths are relative to the BlenderShared root or absolute. Give either `asset` (preferred) or the legacy `bottle`.

asset.description: asset id; the provider is chosen by design_slots.provider_of(asset): lathe_v1 (wine..flask, rebuilt in Blender), lathe_v2 (v2_<name> -> export/v2/bottle_<name>.glb, labels merged into the untouched GLB), container (container_<name> -> export/container_<name>.glb, merged). See docs/bottle_designs.md 'Providers'.

bottle.description: legacy alias of asset for the lathe_v1 bottles

lod_paths.description: override the base GLB per label tier (paths relative to the root). Defaults: lathe_v2 HIGH=bottle_x.glb, MEDIUM=_lod1, LOW/MINIMAL=_lod2; container HIGH=container_x.glb, others=_lod1.

thickness_mm.description: shader hint only; the wall mesh is fixed

glass.description: written to extras; the runtime helper (designs/godot/bottle_design.gd) applies it as a glass override

label.description: image/generate for the cap_top disc slot

liquid.description: Written to extras.liquid and the .liquid.json sidecar. viscosity, opacity, tint_strength, density and the bubble_size runtime setter are not honoured by the shaders yet (see TODO(owner) in docs/bottle_designs.md).

spare_slots.description: slots that get an invisible placeholder mesh so a runtime image can be dropped in

slot.description: slot name of the asset (designs/slots.json; tables in docs/bottle_designs.md)

wear_mask.description: greyscale PNG; G channel becomes roughness (HIGH tier only)

offset.description: [x, y] mm shift of the label centre inside the slot
